lines: - "The Orokin only wanted ceremonial weapons on the Zariman, but for something as important as the Reliquary Drive, they built in two little security guarantees: auto-fabricating Armaments and Exodampers. Exodampers suppress enemy combat ability. We need to defend our Exodampers and our Reliquary with Armaments. Got that?"
- "We use Argozene to build the Armaments. I marked an Argozene drop on your radar. Think you can manage to find it?"
- "Hey, Yonta. How many of those big finger-relics are out there, d'you think?"

- "You're a natural. Now, I'm sure you want to go crazy building armaments all over, but you cannot do that. You need to use sockets. Go find the socket that appeals to you most - your socket, the socket that was meant for you - and build something dangerous in it."

- "Mercy me, I do believe you've got the hang of this, Grubber. One more thing. Enemies coming through Oro Works are always helping themselves to our Argozene, so feel free to take it from their cold dead hands."
- "Don't bother trying to hurt Kira's Angel form now. She's pulled her essence back into the Void. You're gonna have to follow her in there."
- "That's her. The real Kira. If you don't take her out here, she'll heal."
- "Those orbs will redirect any damage you can do! Try throwing yourself through them."
- "Kira's almost recovered. You need to put her down."

- "I'm not here to be your friend. I'm not sure why I'm here at all. But I'll keep you alive. These? Used to be museum fodder. Ceremonial and all that Golden piss-talk. But now? Real weapons. Void-touched. Not fashion accessories. Not conversation pieces. They are for killing. We good?"
- "I'll say this for the Zariman kids. They fought like demons."
- "Grineer workers. With guns. Why would anyone be that stupid."
- "It's a good thing we never made it to Tau. Too many weaklings on board."
- "Can't believe the idiots who fitted out this colony ship thought we wouldn't need proper weapons."
- "This place is your home, grubber. You gonna let the Grineer and the Corpus help themselves to it?"
- "Can't do a Void-damned thing for the dead, but I mean to keep you from joining 'em."
- "They aren't making Grineer like they used to. The old ones could lose an arm and they'd keep on working."
- "A whole Empire, gone. Guess the Dax weren't so tough, huh?"
- "This body of mine looks like flesh, but it ain't. You can hurt it real bad and it will keep going. So trust me when I say these weapons have all been well tested."
- "Back in the day, Granum wanted me as an enforcer. Fat percentage and "special Corpus perks". But I told him where to stick it. I got standards."
- "Don't bring your tales of sorrow to this door. You want tea and sympathy, go find Hombask."
- "Quinn and Yonta, down here in the garbage with the rest of us grubbers. Never get tired of that."
- "Goods are on the table. Let's talk."
- "Make your time count. You'll be a long time dead, grubber."
- "If you're not ready to fight, just keep walking."
- "Only place to find decent weapons on this Void-forsakened ship."
- "Always got time for a fellow enthusiast."
- "Weapons with a touch of the Void."
- "Take a closer look if you need to."
- "Admire all you like, but even my time shouldn't be wasted."
- "Once it's out of my hands, it's no longer my responsibility."
- "Take the time to build up a bond with it."
- "Remember, these weapons aren't just hardware. They're alive."
- "A pinch of the Void, and any weapon can be made to sing a new tune."
- "So. You interested in custom tune-ups for your gear?"
- "Here's a few pieces I put together in my own time. Void knows I got plenty of that."
- "Don't go bothering me about this unless you got an Incarnon weapon in your hands."
- "Evolve what? Grubber. Hello! You don't have an Incarnon weapon equipped."
- "If you die, I got dibs on your stuff."

- "Look, what do you want from me? "Sorry I was such an asshole?" No. If I'd been less of an asshole, Margulis would've found a lot more dead kids on this ship. My way works. But... I'm glad I didn't scare you off. I'm pretty sure you've faced worse than me anyway. Don't ever quote me on this, but... it's been an honor."
- "You got a killer rep, Grubber. Happy to help you keep it that way."
- "You ever get tired of the constant killing? Nope. Me neither."
- "I watch you on the scope sometimes, y'know. Some of those moves... I thought only a Dax could pull them off."
- "Whoever trained you has nothing to reproach themselves for. You measure up in all the ways that matter."
- "I used to think that dying on the field was insurance against ever wearing out. Now I'm looking down the barrel of eternity."
- "If I ever start with the self-pity, please, drag me to the nearest airlock and throw me out."
- "These new Grineer may not be bright but they got a bond. Wish we had them back on our side."
- "Thank the Void I don't have kids. Thought about it, but... nah. Line ends here."
- "Never married. Never found anyone I hated enough to condemn to a life with me."
- "I thought loading myself with explosives and going out in a blaze of glory was the perfect way for a guy like me to go. But it didn't solve a damn thing."
- "Nothing scared me in years, except... that voice. Couldn't even understand what it was saying."
- "Getting pretty tired of humans. Might get myself a Kubrow."
- "Most of you kids made it. That's gotta be worth something."
- "That one will be slow to wake. But when it does, I hope you're ready."
- "Good things come to those who wait. Bad things too. This Void Angel won't be happy you woke it."
- "That's a Void Angel in the making. Best be ready."
- "When that thing starts moving, and it will, you'd better know what to do."
- "That was a dormant Void Angel. And now it's not dormant anymore."
- "Remember that Void Angel you were messing with before? Here it is now."
- "Here comes that Void Angel you woke up. Get ready."
- "Here's that extra Void Angel you ordered, grubber."
This section is transcluded from [[Exterminate/Quotes#Zariman Ten Zero｜Exterminate/Quotes § Zariman Ten Zero]]. To change it, please edit the transcluded page.
- Cavalero: "Grineer grunts are hunting for Kuva on our ship. Get in there and carve them up."
- Cavalero: "Boarding party. Grineer clones, half-rotten already. Wipe 'em out."
- Cavalero: "Grineer only understand violence. Show them they don't belong in our home."
- Cavalero: "Greedy plundering Corpus bastards have come aboard without permission. Mow them down without a second thought."
- Cavalero: "These Corpus ain't here to trade. They're looking to steal from us. Give them hell."
- Cavalero: "We got a bunch Granum clowns looking for easy salvage. We are nobody's free lunch. Bust some heads."
- Cavalero: "Don't slow down now. Body count can go way higher!"
- Cavalero: "So long as they keep coming, you keep killing."
- Cavalero: "No flagging! You're my favorite little meat grinder!"
- Cavalero: "Don't let your weapons cool down. Lots more fighting to do!"
- Cavalero: "They finally got the message. Grineer backing off. Good work."
- Cavalero: "You broke them. Nice. Keep hitting them hard enough and eventually they'll get it."
- Cavalero: "They wanted to do things the hard way and now they're done. Grineer are pulling out. Great job."
- Cavalero: "Granum can mark this one down as a net loss. Corpus forces retreating. You did good."
- Cavalero: "Corpus goons are going back to daddy Parvos empty-handed. You sent them running."
- Cavalero: "Busted helmets and boots full of blood all over the deck. Corpus are broken, I'm kinda impressed."
This section is transcluded from Void Armageddon/Quotes. To change it, please edit the transcluded page.
- Cavalero: "Grineer are attacking the Reliquary Drive again. That's waking the Angels. Deploy armaments and keep the Exodampers online. Protect that drive."
- Cavalero: "Corpus attack inbound. They're targeting the reliquary and the Angels will take notice. Build armaments, safeguard the Exodampers, and keep the drive stable."
- Cavalero: "Reliquary ahead. Exodampers blunt enemy capability. They'll target them first."
- Cavalero: "Enemies will hit our Exodampers first so they can fight unimpeded. Then they'll target our Reliquary Drive."
- Cavalero: "Defend the reliquary but don't neglect the Exodampers. Their fields keep enemies on the backfoot."
- Cavalero: "You'll need Argozene. I'm sending you a canister now."
- Cavalero: "Reckon you could use more Argozene?"
- Cavalero: "You got some Argozene. Go build."
- Cavalero: "The more Argozene you have, the more armaments you can construct."
- Cavalero: "Do not let this wave of scum take out that Exodamper."
- Cavalero: "They're hitting an Exodamper. Hit them first."
- Cavalero: "They're throwing more losers at you."
- Cavalero: "Don't let up. More no-marks incoming."
**If at least one Exodamper has been destroyed**
- Cavalero: "Enemy have exposed our reliquary. Get it defended!"
- Cavalero: "Not done yet. More coming. Prioritize the reliquary!"
- Cavalero: "You kept that Exodamper standing. Good work."
- Cavalero: "The Exodamper made it, but they'll be back."
- Cavalero: "Exodamper down! You just gave them a clear path to the drive!"
- Cavalero: "Exodamper disabled. Do a better job protecting the drive."
- Cavalero: "Exodamper out of action. Watch that flank!"
- Cavalero: "Took down an Exodamper. Getting stronger."
- Cavalero: "One less Exodamper, that's a boost to the enemy."

path: Ravenous Angel Spawn After Three Waves
lines: - Cavalero: "Confirming a Void Angel at your location."
- Cavalero: "Reading Void Angel signature heading right for the reliquary."
- Cavalero: "A Void Angel just woke up and is looking to snack on the relic."
- Cavalero: "Grubber, the Angel is trying to retreat into the Void so it can heal. Follow it and stop it."

path: Dimensional Orbs Spawn And Ethereal Angel Invincible
lines: - Cavalero: "You can't hurt it while those dimensional orbs are out. Use your Void body to absorb them."
- Cavalero: "The Angel's almost recovered. Hurry this up!"
- Cavalero: "Good. Now it will stay hurt."
- Cavalero: "That's the way. Break it down, body and soul."
- Cavalero: "Yes. It won't be shrugging that off."
- Cavalero: "You weren't fast enough. Now it's healed."
- Cavalero: "Stop that Angel now or we're all finished!"
- Cavalero: "Stop that Void Angel from feeding, Grubber!"
- Cavalero: "Good work Grubber. Here's where we divide the spoils. Extract if you want or hold out for more."
- Cavalero: "Won us some breathing space and a share of what we were able to loot from them. Extract when you are ready."
- Cavalero: "They committed so many troops to this attack they forgot to defend their crewships. Here's your share. You're clear to extract."
- Cavalero: "The longer you hold the fort, the more we can loot from our would-be boarders. Hope you're having as much as I am."
- Cavalero: "While you're keeping them busy, we're helping ourselves to their stuff. You get a cut of course."
- Cavalero: "All the fighting down there in Oro Works is one hell of a useful distraction."
- Cavalero: "Hey, look what uncle Cavalero found."
- Cavalero: "I'll put this on the pile."
- Cavalero: "Hey don't let success go to your head."
- Cavalero: "Don't even think of throwing in the towel now."
- Cavalero: "You got to wonder what possessed these goons thinking they could gain mastery over the Void. Maybe some of them are possessed."
- Cavalero: "There's some kind of a fire in these no-hopers pushing them. And I can't work it out."
- Cavalero: "These wasters fighting like their lives don't matter. They're driven. I've seen that kind of fury on this ship before, once."
- Cavalero: "Don't give these fools your slaughter a second thought. The Void's already starting to take them. I can feel it."
- Cavalero: "That Angel is full up. It's over. Get out of there."
- Cavalero: "That Angel compromised the reliquary. Retreat and regroup."
- Cavalero: "It's over, damn it. The Angel's fed. This is my fault."
- Cavalero: "The relic's taking a pounding, Grubber. You're meant to stop that."
- Cavalero: "The relic cannot endure this amount of punishment. Do better!"
- Cavalero: "If they destabilize the relic, this mission's a failure. It cannot defend itself."
- Cavalero: "They're ripping that relic wide open!"
- Cavalero: "Relic's barely hanging on, Grubber. Hope you got a miracle in you."
- Cavalero: "Relic is almost destabilized. This is not sustainable."

path: If no rounds completed / Mission Failure
lines: - Cavalero: "They destablized the relic. We're done."
- Cavalero: "Reliquary compromised. Get your stuff and clear out. We've failed."
- Cavalero: "This was all too much for you. They won, we lost. Go lick your wounds."

path: If at least one round completed
lines: - Cavalero: "You let them destabilize the relic, but it will recover with time. Get out of there while you still have skin."
- Cavalero: "Reliquary compromised. Nothing more you can do. Find self-extraction."
- Cavalero: "It's over. Nothing more you can do right now. Self-extract and regroup."
- Cavalero: "Reliquary is secure. You did good Grubber."
- Cavalero: "Reliquary is safe. Don't go looking all smug about it."
- Cavalero: "Not bad. Room for improvement, but not bad."
> Heard you been grubbing around in the Zariman's backyard. That little tinpot 'kingdom.'

> Well, in my extensive downtime, I've been having thoughts about weapons. How I could upgrade 'em. Give 'em a sprinkle of Void magic. And guess what? The Void does what the Void does. Took my ideas and made them real. How about that.
> So if you've picked up a... let's call it an Incarnon Genesis, why not? An Incarnon Genesis, bring it to me and I'll get it installed for ya.

> PS. Yonta says I need to say this very clearly: I cannot adapt a weapon you do not own. I will need both the Incarnon Genesis AND the weapon it applies to. Understood? I am not running a charity here.”
